item.title: Tuesday 1 PM Update, Nov 17
item.description:
The Tuesday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 17, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow; the NSA's classified internal network goes down, and the US loses its measles elimination status; tense moments at Hung Cao's Navy hearing; the Quad summit in Manila and a journalist killed in Costa Rica; stocks slide at midday as Jensen Huang says he'd return to Nvidia, Disney and Home Depot beat, and health insurers drop; what really broke Outlook, and new details on the Megaspeed probe; Gemini starts making calls and buying things for you; Oracle's Java patches and an extradited ransomware suspect; your X feed; Monadnock Community Hospital confirms a cyber incident and New Hampshire's stalled dam removals; and two Connecticut teens whose school supply drive went global. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

AP, "Trump's pick for Navy secretary acknowledges the Iran war is straining military resources" (Nov 17); The New Republic, hearing transcript excerpts (Nov 17); C-SPAN (Nov 17) - White House, "Quad Leaders' Summit Joint Press Release" (Nov 17); Prime Minister's Office of Japan (Nov 17); Hindustan Times (Nov 17); The Hindu, "Japan offers ASEAN nations access to energy storage" (Nov 17); AP live updates (Nov 17) - BBC, "Gunmen kill Costa Rican journalist who reported on drugs trade" (Nov 17); Tico Times (Nov 17); RSF (Nov 17) - Yahoo Finance live, 12:44 p.m. ET (Nov 17); 24/7 Wall St., "S&P 500 Drops 1.3% at Midday" (Nov 17); Baystreet.ca, "TSX Slumps Midday" (Nov 17); CNBC, "Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says he's open to returning" (Nov 17); item.title: Tuesday 10 AM Update, Nov 17
item.description:
The Tuesday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 17, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow; Navy secretary nominee Hung Cao's confirmation hearing and DHS saying the recent outages were not an attack; Iranian drones at a US radar site in Bahrain and a second strike on the Crimean bridge; Turkey seizes the opposition channel Sozcu TV; stocks mixed at the open after a soft retail sales report, Intel slides as Nvidia trims its stake, and the Deutsche Bank files leak; Nvidia's new national security committee; Isomorphic Labs raises five billion dollars and Google retires Gemini Gems; the Fugaku supercomputer breach and attacks on Check Point gateways; your X feed; the Saint-Gobain PFAS meeting and the Associated Grocers strike; and the teachers who built a bus stop for a student. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Tuesday Morning, Nov 17
item.description:
The Tuesday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 17, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather with the full seven-day forecast; a CNN report on Iranian planning for a dirty bomb in Washington, what caused Monday's bank outages, and today's nationwide emergency alert test; Ukraine brings down part of the Crimean bridge as Russia hits bridges in Kyiv; President Trump at the ASEAN summit in Manila and new tanker attacks near Hormuz; futures slip ahead of Nvidia earnings as Disney and Home Depot report; Apple limits Siri's heavier AI tasks and tightens Mac permissions for AI agents; California sues OpenAI over runaway AI agents, and Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max; hijacked Optimizely code on CNN, Zoom and 176 other organizations' sites, and an Uber driver data breach; your X feed; a Lake Winnipesaukee island fire and the Lindsay Clancy retrial date; and the New Hampshire school that saved last winter's snow. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
